reason: Batch 003 source audit removed unsupported parking-structure geometry locators. PD 1096 Rule VII supports slot/loading sizes and plan indication; BP 344 supports accessible parking details. Rule XIX, Section 803, and Section 904 are not parking geometry locators.

proposed.text: Under the checked PD 1096 Rule VII parking provisions, what is the source-backed minimum size for an average automobile slot for perpendicular or diagonal parking?
proposed.rationale: PD 1096 Rule VII supports 2.50 m x 5.00 m for average automobile slots at perpendicular or diagonal parking.
proposed.explanation: The old 6.1 m aisle question cited the wrong PD 1096 locator and was not supported by the cited sources.
proposed.code_citation: PD 1096 2004 Revised IRR, Rule VII parking slot requirements
